title: Home
---

A clean page. Every planted failure on this site is conditional — on the
viewport, on the preferred colour scheme, or on the selected Quarto theme — so
this page exists to show what an unconditional cell looks like, and to give the
website project a landing page.

Keep it free of images, links and inline code: an unconditional finding here
would appear in all four cells of every comparison this site is here to make.
